changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1.1 improves the channel-management UI and save feedback, stabilizes Personalized TV handoff on Jellyfin for Android by using the same confirmed-loading flow as Web/webOS, prevents failed handoffs from leaving an infinite loading screen, and makes Hide from Android TV compatible with legacy and current Jellyfin Android TV client names including Google TV/Fire TV deployments.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
name: Virtual TV
overview: Virtual linear TV channels inside Jellyfin.
